additional_info.subject: ID0453310-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001958] DC1-DC1_QA21-22, COMMAND: on, FEEDBACK: off, BLOCKING: no, OPRSTATE: AbNormal(off FBK while on) CRM:00315003034
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0453310
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Energu
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
MP / R6 170001958
Charger ID / Serial No.:1Vukib
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution: Looks like the StateMonitor is not closing the contactor. I recommend replacing the KF14, otherwise please confirm if the contactors are really closing then:
​​​​​​​Also worth to check if the XD10.1 is properly connected and the 24V are not being applied to the contactors. If we have 24V then check directly in the busbar with crocodile tips without having any contact with the charger and have a EV to test the session.
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​If all these options above fail, then it is must likely related to the TF2. We need to check the 2...10V output and see if it's ok. Also there is the XD10.3 that is loose sometimes too:
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
​​​​​​​Otherwise try to replace it
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​MLFBs according to schematic:
​​​​​​​KF13 - 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA1
QA13-14 - 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
TF2 - 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
